errors.k1: GTFO was not found. Click the game status at the top right and choose the game folder.
errors.k2: GTFO is running and the plugin files are in use. Quit the game and try again; updating only the skin does not need that.
errors.k3: A file it needs is gone, maybe moved or deleted. Choose the texture or model again.
errors.k4: Some texture files cannot be found. Check the texture folder, or choose the red textures again on the right.
errors.k5: A file path cannot be used. Move the textures to a normal folder and try again.
errors.k6: This model file cannot be read. Export it again as .glb (from Blender, for example) and import that.
errors.k7: A screen has a size of 0. Check its width and height.
errors.k8: The screen digit font could not be built. Try another font.
errors.k9: Frames for an animated texture could not be built. Check that the video or images open.
errors.k10: An attachment has neither a model nor a screen. Import a model, turn on the screen, or delete it.
errors.k11: An attachment is not mounted on any part. Select it and choose a part on the right.
errors.k12: No textures replaced yet. Drop in a texture folder and try again.
errors.k13: The background service stopped and is restarting. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.k14: The background service did not understand this request, probably a version mismatch. Update to the latest version; if that does not help, send the log to the author.
errors.k15: A sound file is not usable Ogg audio. Choose the file again under Sounds and it will be converted.
errors.k16: A trigger setting is incomplete: “Loop for N seconds” needs more than 0 seconds, and attachment effects need an event and more than 0 seconds.
errors.k17: An image cannot be read. Open it in an image viewer to check, or try PNG.
errors.k18: A position, rotation or scale value is invalid. Reset it on the right and try again.
errors.k19: This weapon no longer exists in this game version. Pick the weapon again.
errors.k20: This skin has no id. Save the project as a new copy and try again.
errors.k21: This skin pack is broken. Export or apply it again.
errors.k22: Weapon previews are not ready. Wait for the progress at the bottom left to finish.
errors.k23: This folder is not a game profile. Choose an r2modman profile folder (one with BepInEx) or the GTFO game folder.
errors.k24: The ammo screen settings are wrong. Check what the screen shows.
errors.k25: That did not finish. Try again; if it keeps happening, open the log for details.
